summary: SEH-guarded destructor wrapper for a std::logic_error exception object. Sets up an SEH handler frame whose landing pad is global 0x0059D59C, resets the exception object's vtable to std::logic_error, releases the internal string buffer via a reference-count decrement with conditional free, toggles a frame guard flag from 0 to -1, and chains to the underlying MSVC exception destructor.

local_names.v1: exception object pointer (arrives via ecx, uninitialized in decompiler view)
local_names.v2: saved copy of the exception object pointer for the final chain
local_names.a1: caller frame pointer; frame-relative slots a1-16 and a1-4

operations.description: Initialize the SEH handler frame on the stack; the landing pad at global 0x0059D59C is the continuation point.
Save the exception object pointer for the final destructor chain: v2 = v1.
Store the exception object pointer into the stack frame slot (a1 - 16) for the SEH landing pad.
Write the std::logic_error vtable into the exception object: *v1 = &std::logic_error::`vftable'.
Release the exception's internal string buffer: ReferenceCountDecrementWithConditionalFree(v1 + 3, 1).
Set the frame guard flag to released: *(a1 - 4) = -1.
Chain to the underlying MSVC exception destructor: MSVCExceptionDestructor(v2).
